codeReview.summary: The fix commit fully addresses the four previously blocking frontend reliability findings. `apiFetch` is now the shared retry path used by the app's real authenticated callers, the dead `useApiCall` hook is removed while `apiFetch` exposes `onRetry`, and the WebSocket hook now mutates the real effect-scoped cancellation ref and clears stale `connected` state during cleanup. I found no remaining blocking issues in the reviewed diff.

issues.description: The convenience `authFetch` wrapper still narrows general `RequestInit` compatibility by JSON-parsing `body` and forwarding only a subset of fetch options (`method`, parsed `body`, optional `timeout`) into `apiFetchWithRetry`. This limitation predates the fix and does not block the reviewed feature because `ProtectedLayoutShell` still mounts `useAuthenticatedFetch()` only for token-registration side effects while the app's real request sites call `apiFetch(...)` directly.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `refactor-worker` still describes a mandatory red-phase failing-test step for new functionality even on frontend-only work in this repo, where mission guidance explicitly says no frontend test infrastructure exists. That mismatch encourages handoffs to report full procedure compliance even when build + lint are the only realistic validators.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md:41-45` requires writing failing tests first for new functionality, while mission `AGENTS.md:87` says 'No frontend tests — out of scope'. This worker's handoff for session `6910e654-15e4-4c46-b8cf-67315342d1cd` reports `tests.added: []` and `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true` after validating only `npm --prefix frontend run build` and `npm --prefix frontend run lint`.

summary: Reviewed the feature record, prior failed review reports, worker handoff, transcript skeleton, commit `fe86cc51eeb67585ca57e0540f6fae321d7da44a`, and the current frontend code. The fix now resolves the prior blocking API retry wiring, dead-hook, disconnect-cancellation, and stale-connected-state failures without introducing any new blocking regression; one pre-existing non-blocking `useAuthenticatedFetch` compatibility limitation remains.
